summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Thirty-three source leads recorded for China-Nepal economic relations. The single permitted WebSearch located the MoFA Nepal page carrying the text of the Framework for Belt and Road Cooperation (signed December 2024) plus China-side and secondary records of it; the remaining leads are reused from the shared register and upstream agents: Nepal customs trade book FY2022/23 and portal (office-level data), NTIP, UN Comtrade mirror data, MOFCOM/State Council releases on LDC zero-tariff treatment, NRB FDI survey reports FY2022/23 and FY2023/24, DoI/IBN, FITTA 2019 and NRB FDI bylaw, MoF Development Cooperation Reports, PDMO debt bulletin, ICIMOD's 2026 Kyirong-Rasuwa flood note and NITDB. Q1 (volume/composition via northern points) is pending office-level customs data. Q2 (under construction vs proposed) is set up as a register in which no project is classified until an implementing record exists. Q3 (FDI commitments vs actual) separates pledges, approvals, realised inflows and ODA; all values pending. Qualitative domestic constraints (unverified legal character of the BRI framework; hazard exposure of northern routes) are labelled assumptions. No numbers are recorded.

findings.claim: Q1a: Value of Nepal's trade with China (imports and exports) passing through northern customs offices, by office (Rasuwa, Tatopani and others), Nepal FY2022/23 onward, and the northern share of total Nepal-China trade.
findings.note: Customs trade books and office-level data (04B-L10, L11, L12); most China-origin imports may enter via Indian ports and southern offices - route and origin must be separated.

findings.claim: Q1b: Composition (HS chapter) of trade through northern border points, Nepal FY.
findings.note: Customs office x HS cross-tabulation required (04B-L10, L11); mirror check with China-reported data (04B-L13), calendar year.

findings.claim: Q1c: Closure/disruption days at northern crossings (incl. the 2026 Kyirong-Rasuwa flood) by crossing and year.
findings.note: ICIMOD event note establishes the event (04B-L28); closure and reopening dates require customs/MoFA notices.

findings.claim: Q2: Status of announced Nepal-China connectivity projects (cross-border railway, northern roads and border ports, cross-border transmission, projects associated with the December 2024 BRI framework) is set up in specific.project_status_register; no project is classified as under construction until an implementing record (financing agreement, contract award, MoF DCR disbursement, agency progress report) is retrieved.
findings.note: BRI framework text located (04B-L01, L04); project list only in secondary sources (L05, L06) pending verification against MoF DCR (L25, L26), PDMO (L27) and IBN (L20).

findings.claim: Q3a: FDI commitments (approvals) from China, Nepal FY, from Department of Industry/IBN records.
findings.note: DoI approval statistics by country (04B-L21), IBN approvals and summit commitments (L20); summit pledges are a third category, not approvals.

findings.claim: Q3b: Realised FDI inflows and stock from China, Nepal FY.
findings.note: NRB FDI survey reports FY2022/23 and FY2023/24 (04B-L17, L18); BoP inflows (L19). Ratio of realised to committed computed only when both series use matching definitions and periods (00B conflict C-13 area).

findings.claim: Q3c: China official development assistance (grant and loan) commitments vs disbursements, Nepal FY.
findings.note: MoF Development Cooperation Reports (04B-L25, L26) and PDMO debt bulletin (L27); ODA is distinct from FDI and reported separately.

findings.claim: Method: three distinct investment categories are kept separate - (i) pledges/MoUs at summits or visits, (ii) regulatory approvals (DoI/IBN), (iii) realised inflows (NRB FDI survey/BoP); ODA from China (MoF DCR) is a separate stream. No ratio is formed across mismatched definitions or FY/CY periods.
Method: Chinese statistics (MOFCOM outward investment, China customs) are calendar year; Nepal series are Nepal FY; comparisons use documented conversion or are reported side by side.

Domestic policy constraint (qualitative, to verify against 04B-L01 text): the December 2024 BRI framework is a cooperation framework; whether it creates binding obligations or financing commitments must be established from its text before any project is treated as financed. Domestic fiscal and debt policy therefore cannot assume BRI financing terms (grant vs loan) until project-level agreements are retrieved.

Domestic policy constraint (qualitative): northern-route trade capacity is exposed to cryosphere hazards (2026 Kyirong-Rasuwa flood, 04B-L28), so northern connectivity cannot be treated as a reliable substitute for India transit in supply-security planning until operating and disruption records exist (consistent with 17B-A2 and 21B challenge).
This register describes documented arrangements and their implied constraints; it does not state or represent the position of the Government of Nepal or the Government of the PRC.

data_gaps: Customs office-level trade data for northern points FY2023/24-FY2025/26 (document-level URLs not located).
Official list and stage of projects under the December 2024 BRI framework (MoF/MoFA/IBN).
Nepal-China transit transport agreement and protocol texts and any implementation record.
Closure/reopening records for Rasuwagadhi and Tatopani crossings, 2025-2026.
Department of Industry FDI approvals by country (document-level URL); MOFCOM outward FDI statistical bulletin entry for Nepal.
Tourist arrivals from China by entry point (Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation) - no lead located.
China customs (GACC) data - no catalog id (see 17B challenge to 00A).

assumptions.text: Pledges, approvals, realised FDI and ODA are distinct categories and are never netted or ratioed across mismatched definitions.
Project status classes follow 17B-A1; announced projects enter scenarios only as options (17B-A2).
Origin (China-made goods) and route (northern crossing) are measured separately.
Policy-constraint statements are qualitative and do not represent any government's position.

challenges.text: 17B recorded no document-level lead for Nepal-China framework texts; 04B located the MoFA page for the December 2024 BRI framework (04B-L01) and the China-side release (04B-L04). Please adopt these leads in 17B policy_watchlist so the status assessment has one shared source.
For the 00B FDI commitments-vs-flows conflict entry, 04B proposes the four-category split (pledges, approvals, realised, ODA); please confirm definitions so 12B and 04B use one series per category.
Add catalog ids for MoCTCA (tourism statistics), China GACC and MOFCOM outward-FDI bulletin before r2.

uncertainty: Very high for r1: no document was downloaded. The only new document-level lead (BRI framework text) was identified from a search listing; its content, including legal character and validity, is unverified. The project list is drawn from upstream watchlists and secondary sources and may be incomplete or outdated. Northern trade volumes, FDI series and disruption durations are unknown.

northern_trade_profile.period_basis: Nepal FY; China mirror data calendar year kept separate
northern_trade_profile.method: Office-level customs data: northern offices (Rasuwa/Kerung corridor, Tatopani/Zhangmu corridor, other northern points) vs all other entry points for trade with China; HS-chapter composition per office; monthly series to date closures; mirror check with UN Comtrade China-reported data.

components.data_required: Imports/exports by customs office and partner, Nepal FY2022/23-FY2025/26
Nepal-China trade total vs northern-office subtotal
Zero-tariff coverage for Nepal and post-LDC-graduation applicability (with 21A/26B)
Tourist arrivals from China by entry point (air vs land) - Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation statistics (no lead located in r1); Nepal-China flight frequencies (CAAN)

project_status_register.method: Status classes per 17B-A1; a project is 'under construction' only with a contract award/financing agreement and a progress or disbursement record (MoF DCR, PDMO, implementing agency); 'proposed' covers studies, DPRs, MoUs and framework listings. News and secondary analyses only locate documents.

fdi_commitment_vs_actual.method: Ratio of realised FDI (NRB survey/BoP) to approvals (DoI/IBN) for China, by FY and cohort where possible; pledges at summits listed separately; ODA (MoF DCR) reported separately. Definitions from FITTA 2019 and NRB bylaw.

fdi_commitment_vs_actual.conflict_register_link: 00B conflict entry involving 12B/04B (commitments vs flows; FY vs CY)
